svg.title: Published work, 04 Publications
svg.desc: 04 / PUBLICATIONS. Published work. Research that stands like stones beside the falls. A moonlit lagoon below a small waterfall, three moss-green standing stones, each engraved with one publication and lit by a small glass lamp at its foot. Wiley book chapter: Real-Time Monitoring and Predictive Maintenance. DOI 10.1002/9781394303601.ch14. Springer: Analysis of Received Signal Strength Based on User Position Locating by Using ML Method. Machine learning for locating user position. Zenodo: Standardizing Denial Management in Behavioral Health: A Quantitative Audit Protocol for Practice Revenue-Cycle Maturity. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18453640.
